source.title: A new species of Myotis from China with notes on the siligorensis species group (Chiroptera, Vespertilionidae)

where: Diagnosis. paragraph (heading 'Diagnosis.'), sentence 'The measurements of the holotype (in mm) were as follows'
quote: The measurements of the holotype (in mm) were as follows: body length – 35, tail length – 28, length of the free tail tip – 0.5, ear length – 11.9, tragus length – 5.5, […]
method: external measurement of the holotype as printed in the Diagnosis prose; Methods: external measurements taken to the nearest 0.1 mm with a dial caliper, specimens fixed in 75% ethanol
conditions: Adult male holotype IBSS CQ-08c-16 ('adult male, body in 75% alcohol, skull and baculum extracted'). The paper has no external-measurement table; values only in this Diagnosis sentence. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
note: Quote is the sentence start through the ear length value; the sentence continues with further measurements (cut marked […]), none a qualifier of this value. Methods list 'E' as ear length and 'Tr' as tragus length (page tool output, no further definition of landmarks). Sentence reassembled from two consecutive pieces returned by the page tool. Name: Mammal Diversity Database taxon 1006997 lists Myotis kalkoae, Vespertilionidae, holotype IBSS CQ-08c-16, no synonyms, 'recently described'. Not on main (grep of docs/ for species, DOI and id). method: external measurement of the holotype as printed in the description; Methods (as recorded for desk-d345/audit 460 on this paper): measurements to the nearest 0.1 mm with digital calipers, specimens fixed in 95% ethanol
conditions: Adult male holotype (field number XZ2023010), body mass 3.36 g. Values printed to 0.01 mm. Table 4 and the Methods were not re-read by this desk. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
where: Murina milinensis sp. nov. account, line under the heading 'Measurements (in mm) and body weight (in g) of the holotype.'
